label: B25-RX-OBSERVABILITY-NOFP-PROFILE
title: Rebase the scalar no-FP board profile onto the RX observability candidate
scope: Apply the already accepted one-line A64_FP_SIMD default 1-to-0 diagnostic profile to exact RX observability candidate 85992f53. Preserve every RXDBG, M20K, UART, cache, QSF and SDC byte and freeze a new derivative SHA before physical execution.

validation.scope: The only non-ledger source delta from 85992f53 is the board-top A64_FP_SIMD default 1'b1 to 1'b0.
validation.static: No-FP parameter propagation, core/SoC/board elaboration and synthesis selector remain green.
validation.focused: Current 1204-byte RXDBG monitor image contract, corrected M20K timing and vendor JTAG-UART bridge tests remain green.
validation.soc: A combined no-FP full-SoC smoke reaches READY and validates periodic/dynamic RXDBG, status, PONG and echo in CAL-OK/WAIT/FAIL scenarios.

acceptance: A content-addressed derivative profile is committed with exactly one functional source-line change and all affected L0-L2 checks pass; it remains explicitly non-release and becomes T-007's physical input.
resource: Static/focused checks may run unlocked when light. The combined no-FP full-SoC smoke must acquire local; return 75 means wait without bypassing the lock.
forbidden_regions: core FP/NEON RTL, RX observability RTL, monitor semantics, M20K RTL, QSF or SDC changes
claiming full-FP or final release equivalence
